summary:
DESIGN SYSTEM and VISUAL POLISH plan (no-build). Long-form report (1,660 lines, 37 fix specs, appendices, reproducible scripts) is at report_file. Method: scripted inventory of every colour/type/spacing/radius/shadow/z-index/duration across index.html CSS+JS, site-nav.css/js, 26 sub-pages and the bundle's 613 inline style props (bundle.pretty.js 96200-113377), plus WCAG contrast, CIEDE2000 colour-blind simulation, NOAA solar maths and live font-size measurements.

PROOF OF INCONSISTENCY: 307 colour literals (185 opaque, 122 translucent; 140 perceptual clusters; 95 used once) incl. 30 blue-ish hexes for 'Union', 31 red-ish for 'Confederate', two golds (#c8a84a app vs #c9a24b pages, dE2000 2.9); 41 font-size declarations, 165 below 12 px (50% of the app UI) plus canvas labels at 8-10 px; 42% of 1,153 spacing values off the 4 px grid; 15 radii; 20 durations; 27 z-index levels (up to 999999); 1 media query on the whole site; 0 aria/role, 0 media queries, 0 reduced-motion handling in the app UI; the gold primary button is defined 11 times with 7 paddings; 86 of 260 app text declarations (33%) fail 4.5:1; 108 emoji/letter glyph icons (44 distinct chars) vs a 19-symbol sprite with a dead 'sabers' symbol and 3x reused book/pulse/users icons.

DISCOVERIES THAT CHANGE THE PLAN: (1) C1/C2 root cause = the desktop timeline IO (bundle.pretty.js:113249) and other desktop widgets are mounted unconditionally in Mobile layout; mobile root tn.root is z-index:100 (a stacking context, 103699) and IO (z100, later in DOM, 112386) paints over the whole mobile UI and Tools sheet; IO's 572 px row includes a 'Created by ... e-mail' credit. (2) Legend != map: 9 of 11 posture colours differ from the canvas, legend text describes dots/circles while units are strength-wide rectangles. (3) Side colours are already colour-blind-safe (dE2000 41.7/42.3/51.0/65.8) but postures are not (deutan 7.8 Charging vs Retreat). (4) 'Spectral' (x14) and 'Cormorant Garamond' (x4) are referenced but never loaded anywhere; Georgia cannot legally be self-hosted. (5) og:image/twitter:image/manifest screenshots are one identical malformed gradient placeholder (md5 3f6646c9..., IHDR RGB but RGBA-sized data). Also: C8 root cause verified (search.html:30 chip lacks background; site-nav.css:143-147 button.filter-chip{color:inherit} outranks it => 1.10:1); no error path for boot fetches (infinite splash) and no error boundary; Help renders behind OOB/Roster (z600 vs 800-900); mobile/walkthrough maps hide Mapbox attribution (attributionControl:false 102988/110777); canvas is not devicePixelRatio-aware (blurry on all phones); engaged glow is a 40-screen-px heuristic; two monument systems on one button with a per-frame setState loop.

TARGET SYSTEM: tokens.json (DTCG) -> tokens.css/js with @layer, one hashed app.css (<=4 KB br), validated dark/light/forced-colors/contrast tokens (all contrast numbers measured), Spectral 400+700 self-hosted (~45 KB, OFL) with metric-override fallback and system UI sans, 12 px floor, tabular numerals, spacing/radius/elevation/motion scales with migration map, z-scale --z-map..--z-skip with overlay-root portal and reserved zones, ~50-icon SVG system (Lucide ISC + custom historic set) with full glyph mapping, 16 components with states and acceptance criteria (button, toolbar button, chip, tabs, segmented, cards, panel/sheet, dialog, menu, toast, tooltip, slider, combobox, switch, badge, skeleton), one responsive shell replacing the two forks (grid, dvh, landscape rule, compact chrome 136 px vs 234 px today), panel-management rules P1-P8 (one panel per dock, LayerStack Esc chain, jump hygiene), H1 = Ask the Historian pill + Explore menu in the header (desktop) / top bar + Tools-sheet cards (compact) with the 6 injected scripts (index.html:294-714) and z-999999 overlay deleted, H3 = HTML splash only + auto layout + versioned gb.v2.prefs + welcome card + non-modal coach-mark tour, cartography (symbology.json: colour=side, shape=branch, line style=posture, strength bar; aggregation instead of displacement; >=12 px haloed priority labels; single-source legend; DPR-aware canvas; overlays from data; computed-solar day/night with civil dawn 4:02, sunrise 4:34-4:35, sunset 19:31-19:32, civil dusk 20:04 LMT; hillshade; scale bar; attribution), 22-row motion catalogue, state catalogue (skeleton/empty/error/offline + ErrorBoundary), theming, print stylesheet for Battle Reports, sub-page templates, brand/share assets, governance (stylelint/ESLint/Playwright matrix/axe/styleguide/budgets), 5-phase roadmap (Phase 0 quick wins in days; Phase 2 depends on the N1 source decision).

GRADE IMPACT (design-owned): Visual design B+/B- -> A; Fit and finish C+/D+ -> A; Usability mobile D+ -> A-; Accessibility C+/C -> A- (Lighthouse A11y 90 -> 98-100); plus small performance/CLS gains from removing entrance fades, the 4.9 s forced React splash, per-frame React loops and ~420 lines of injected inline JS.

findings.title: Desktop timeline and widgets mount in Mobile layout; shell roots create stacking contexts (true root cause of C1/C2)
findings.evidence: bundle.pretty.js:113249 `V.jsx(IO, {})` is unconditional while only toolbar (113071) and map (113233) are gated by `Zn !== "mobile"`; mobile root tn.root = `position:fixed; inset:0; zIndex:100; touchAction:"none"` (103699-103706); IO wrapper Po.wrap = `position:absolute; bottom:0; zIndex:100` (112386), later in DOM, so it paints over the mobile UI; toolsOverlay zIndex 500 (104037) is inside the z-100 context; IO's Po.controls row = 5 transport btns + 6 speed btns + Tick label + `Created by: Mike Legere · gettysburginteractivemap@gmail.com` nowrap (112361-112370) = the 572 px row of C1. Even mobile's own tn.playRow is ~380-405 px wide by arithmetic (103813-103858).
findings.root_cause: Two forked app shells sharing one root; desktop-only components never unmounted in compact layout; shell roots set z-index (stacking context) so descendants cannot rise above later siblings.
findings.fix: Phase-0 minimum: mount FF/OF/VF/WF/CF/LF/_F/IO/KF/XF/iO/nO/yO/qF only when layout==='full' (AO 113243-113270); delete zIndex from tn.root and tc.root; render toolsOverlay/slidePanel/modals through a body-level #overlay-root portal at --z-sheet/--z-modal; delete the credit/e-mail from the transport row (move to About). Then the single-shell rebuild (app-design-02).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright at 375x667, 320x568 and 667x375: desktop timeline absent in compact; elementFromPoint at the centre of each of the 14 Tools-sheet items returns that item; every transport button boundingBox within viewport and >=44x44; no horizontal overflow.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: C1, C2 closed; Usability (mobile) D+ -> B-; Core function (mobile) D -> B
findings.correction: Root cause and line evidence confirmed (113249, 113071, 113233, 103699-103706, 112386, 104037, 112361-112370). Fix step (b) is wrong: tc.root (113301, used at 113057) has no zIndex, and tn.root's stacking context comes from position:fixed, so deleting zIndex:100 leaves Po.wrap (z100) still painting over it. Only unmounting IO in compact layout and portaling the Tools sheet fix C1/C2. Gating qF/nO/yO also removes toasts and the sound button on mobile; route them through the single toast region instead.

findings.title: Replace the two app forks with ONE responsive shell (grid regions, dvh, safe-area, landscape rule)
findings.evidence: pO (bundle.pretty.js:102914-103697) is a second complete app: own new z_.Map (102981; desktop 97237; walkthrough 110770 = three GL contexts), own canvas+picking ya (103076), popup, roster, legend, 80x64 minimap, day tabs, scrubber, tools grid + 740 lines of styles tn (103698-104440). Fixed chrome: topBar 52 + dayTabs 42 => map top:94 (103709), bottomBar height:140 (103775) = 234 px: 375x667 leaves 433 px (65%), 667x375 leaves 141 px (38%). manifest.json orientation:landscape.
findings.root_cause: Layout mode chosen by a chooser screen, implemented as two component trees with pixel offsets instead of CSS layout; breakpoints as 13 window.innerWidth reads (8 evaluated once at module load inside style literals ji 98111-98115, gp 102708-102712).
findings.fix: .gb-app{display:grid;block-size:100dvh;grid-template:'top top' var(--toolbar-h) 'dock map' 1fr 'transport transport' auto}; container query <768 px turns docks into a bottom sheet; compact chrome = top 48 + transport 88 = 136 px (80% map in portrait); landscape rule (max-height:500px) 40+56 px; viewport-fit=cover; remove manifest orientation lock; one MapView, shared Dock/Sheet; delete pO+tn (~1,500 lines).
findings.acceptance_test: Playwright matrix 320x568..2560x1440 + 667x375/812x375: map >=74% of viewport height in every compact case; resize 375->1024 flips layout live; exactly one Mapbox map instance; no overlap between toolbar/transport/docks.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Usability mobile D+ -> A-; Fit&finish mobile D+ -> A; -1 WebGL context, -1,500 lines
findings.correction: Evidence confirmed (pO 102914, tn 103698, three new z_.Map sites, top 94 = 52+42, bottomBar 140, manifest landscape). The CSS sketch is invalid: @container (...) { .gb-app {...} } cannot match the container element itself. Use @media (max-width:767px) or a wrapper container. The desktop and mobile Map configs differ (maxBounds, dragPan inertia, NavigationControl), so 'one MapView' must reconcile them. XL is realistic only if source exists (N1).

findings.title: Token system (tokens.json -> tokens.css/js) with cascade layers and a single hashed app.css
findings.evidence: Inventory (tmp-app-design/inventory.py): 307 colour literals (140 perceptual clusters, 95 used once), 41 font-size declarations, 36 spacing values (42% off the 4 px grid), 15 radii, >=16 shadows, 20 durations, 27 z-index levels, 10 font-family strings, 1 CSS media query (site-nav.css:52). Bundle app UI = 613 inline style props, 33 style consts/462 keys, 0 aria/role, 0 media queries; assets/index-b4g7z_2g.css is 149/154 .mapboxgl-* rules. Static HTML: 27 <style> blocks + 51 style="" attributes.
findings.root_cause: Design decisions copy-pasted as literals in 27 <style> blocks, one CSS file and 613 inline objects; inline styles cannot express :hover, :focus-visible, @media, forced-colors, print, pseudo-elements.
findings.fix: design/tokens.json (DTCG) -> node build -> /css/tokens.css (Tier1 primitives, Tier2 semantics; dark default + light + prefers-contrast + forced-colors), /js/tokens.js (canvas & Mapbox paint), tokens.d.ts, styleguide data; `@layer reset,tokens,base,components,utilities,page`; ONE hashed /css/app.<hash>.css via normal <link> (no preload swap). Replaces site-nav.css, 26 inline <style> blocks, index.html:60-253. React: codemod the 33 style consts (style_consts.json) into CSS Modules/gb-* classes; inline style only for dynamic --custom-props.
findings.acceptance_test: No hex/rgb literal outside tokens.css; 0 <style> blocks and 0 style="" in HTML; stylelint+ESLint pass; app.css <=4 KB brotli; CSP style-src 'self' in Report-Only shows 0 violations on HTML pages.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Visual design B+/B- -> A; Fit&finish +1 grade; enables CSP without unsafe-inline for styles
findings.correction: Inventory reproduces. '1 CSS media query' is imprecise: static files hold 8 @media (1 layout max-width:640, 6 reduced-motion, 1 print) and the vendor CSS has 18, so say 'one layout breakpoint'. #c8a84a = 41 uses in the bundle (46 only with the 5 static-page uses) and #c9a24b = 40 in static files. Effort L covers tokens plus static pages only; the React half (613 inline props, 33 consts) needs source and belongs to XL Phase 2.

findings.title: Consolidate colour: one gold/Union/Confederate/neutral ramp, accessible text variants, light + forced-colors themes
findings.evidence: 30 blue-ish, 31 red-ish, 17 gold-ish, 27 grey, 28 near-black hexes. Two golds: #c8a84a (46 uses, app) vs #c9a24b (41, pages) dE2000 2.9. findings.title: Contrast remediation: 33% of app text declarations fail 4.5:1; translucent panels; print colours
findings.evidence: Bundle text colour declarations: #444 x4 = 2.02:1, #555 x14 = 2.64, #666 x32 = 3.43, #777 x7 = 4.40, #8b6914 x8 = 3.87 => 86/260 declarations, 17/57 colours fail (Va.skip 101670, tn.tickInfo 103853). site-nav.css:96,129 #6f7686 = 4.32:1 (4.08 on #12121e). findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Lighthouse A11y +8 pts; Accessibility contrast portion fixed

Translucent-panel figures are off: #8a93a8 over rgba(8,8,18,a) on white is 3.69 (a .80), 3.98 (.82), 4.43 (.85), 4.58 (.86), 5.50 (.92), 5.79 (.94), not 4.49 at .86, and >=5.6 only from about .94. findings.title: C8 root cause: .filter-chip has no background/font and global button.filter-chip{color:inherit} outranks it
findings.evidence: search.html:30 `.filter-chip { padding:5px 12px; border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer }` (no background, no font); chips are <button> (56-59); site-nav.css:143-147 `button.filter-chip{font:inherit;color:inherit;appearance:none}` (0,1,1 > 0,1,0) => inherited #e8e6df on UA ButtonFace #efefef = 1.10:1; .filter-chip.active (0,2,0) wins so only the active chip is legible. Same trap for button.mode-btn/.play-btn/.toggle-btn/.day-tab/.btn/.match.
findings.root_cause: Component styles duplicated per page plus a specificity-raising global reset in another file.
findings.fix: Immediate (S): add background:transparent; font:inherit; font-size:12px to .filter-chip and set colour via `.filter-chip:not(.active){color:var(--muted)}`. Systemic: reset in @layer reset; one .gb-chip (report 5.3) with explicit background/colour/font used by Search filters, Historian suggestions, Compare toggles, Camera modes.
findings.acceptance_test: Computed contrast of every unselected chip on search.html >=4.5:1 (was 1.10); grep 'button.filter-chip' site-nav.css = 0; all chip variants render from .gb-chip.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: C8 closed; Lighthouse color-contrast passes on /search
findings.correction: Root cause confirmed (search.html:30-31/56-59, site-nav.css:143-147). The immediate fix is incomplete and partly inert: font-size:12px on .filter-chip loses to button.filter-chip{font:inherit}. The same override is live, not latent, on .play-btn (camera, ground-remembers, immersive, watch-together at 1.92:1, weight 400) and .toggle-btn (computed 16 px). Fix the reset at zero specificity (:where or @layer reset) in the same change.

findings.title: Typography: load the fonts the code asks for (Spectral self-hosted), 12 px floor, one ramp, tabular numerals
findings.evidence: 'Spectral' x14, 'Cormorant Garamond' x4 in the bundle but no @font-face/Google link/font file in the deploy => all text is Georgia/system/monospace. font-family strings: sans-serif x287, Georgia x54, monospace x28, system-ui x14. 165 font-size declarations <12 px (bundle 135/271=50%); canvas labels bold 8/9/10 px (96663-96665). 8 h1 scales. Splash wordmark 52 px+8 px tracking ALL-CAPS (101618-101620) clips at 375 px. Measured latin woff2 sizes 2026-09-29: Spectral 400 21.7 KB, 600 22.9, 700 23.0; Inter var 48.3; Source Serif 4 var 122; Newsreader var 132; Literata var 85.7. Georgia is Microsoft-owned; core fonts pack never licensed for embedding.

findings.fix: Self-host Spectral 400+700 latin WOFF2 (~45 KB, SIL OFL 1.1, ship OFL.txt; check RFN when subsetting) with font-display:swap and metric-override fallback (@capsize/metrics vs Georgia); system-ui for controls; .gb-num tabular-nums replaces monospace clocks; ramp --fs-2xs 12 px..--fs-display clamp; splash/LCP text on fallback stack; preload only spectral-700 on sub-pages; CSP font-src 'self' (drop fonts.googleapis/gstatic, netlify.toml:19); drop Cormorant; canvas/map labels >=12 px.
findings.acceptance_test: 0 font-size <12 px (stylelint) and canvas label >=12; no font-attributable CLS in a Lighthouse trace; splash h1 is LCP without a webfont; font bytes <=50 KB; OFL.txt served; wordmark fully visible at 320x568.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: A4/D2 fixed; Visual design +; CLS/LCP protected
findings.correction: Spectral x14 and Cormorant x4 confirmed, no @font-face/link/font file in deploy, and CSP font-src at netlify.toml:19 confirmed. woff2 sizes re-measured at 21,696 / 22,936 / 23,036 B. Spectral is SIL OFL 1.1 by Production Type; the Reserved Font Name is not verified. The Georgia licensing statement is legal advice and unverified.

findings.title: Spacing/radius/elevation/motion/breakpoint tokens and a reviewed codemod
findings.evidence: 667/1,153 spacing declarations on a 4 px grid, 486 (42%) off-grid: 10px x122, 6px x96, 14px x76, 3px x28, 7px x26, 18px x25, 5px x22; site-nav.css 65% off-grid. 15 radii; 20 durations (10 ms..5000 ms); one @media (site-nav.css:52) + JS thresholds <500 (98111, 96604), <560 (102708), <=860 (110615).

open_questions: Q-1 Do you want a light theme ('Archive paper', recommended for classrooms/print) or dark-only?
Q-2 education.html: fold into the default theme with a 'larger text and targets' density option (recommended) or keep a distinct classroom theme implemented as a token override?
Q-3 OK to spend ~45 KB on self-hosted Spectral 400+700 (SIL OFL) or use system fonts only?
Q-4 OK to move 'Download Website Tutorial PDF' and 'Toggle Units' out of the top bar and to remove the hide/show eye toggle on the Extra Features control?
Q-5 Which clock convention (local mean solar time vs another 'battle time' convention) will the C3/C4 fix settle on? Day/night styling, tour copy and slider aria-valuetext all depend on it.
Q-6 Product name: 'Animated Battlefield Map' vs 'Interactive Map' (E2) - one name everywhere (title, header, splash, manifest, OG)?
Q-7 Are there licensed or self-owned geodata sources (NPS GIS layers, LOC georeferenced maps) you want to use for accurate roads/works/overlays? Availability and licence were not verified.
Q-8 Track 0b (patch the minified bundle now for H1/C1/C2) vs wait for a proper source rebuild (N1)? This gates Phase 2 scheduling.
Q-9 Do brand assets/logo already exist? The current icons and share screenshots look programmatically generated placeholders.

Unverified in this plan (needs device/browser or measurement at implementation): rendered pixels on real devices, Safari/Firefox behaviour, the satellite-v9 raster layer id in GL JS 3.24.1, hillshade/contour tile bytes, whether 3-D terrain would misalign the canvas overlay, the true timeline bar height (estimated 120-130 px), the CLS contribution of the JS-injected sub-page header, whether Mapbox skips flyTo under reduced motion in 3.24.1, and the OFL Reserved Font Name status of the Spectral files at download time.
verification_summary: The app-design report is highly accurate. About 45 bundle.pretty.js line citations that I opened resolved exactly, and the token inventory, contrast, CVD, solar-time and PNG numbers all reproduce. The catalogue and licence claims I could check were confirmed. Mapbox layer ids and the Terrain v2 names could not be checked, and the Georgia licensing statement is legal advice, so both are unverified. I found two wrong fix mechanics, three false sub-claims, one mis-diagnosis, and several omissions. Wrong fix mechanics: (1) Phase-0 "remove zIndex from tn.root/tc.root" is a no-op or ineffective, because tc.root has no zIndex and position:fixed alone creates the stacking context. Only unmounting IO in compact layout and portaling the sheet fix C1/C2. (2) The @container sketch in 6.1 cannot restyle its own container. False sub-claims: (1) the nO fade opacity works, since the 1.8 s transition runs from 1.2 s to removal at 3.0 s. (2) 8 of 11 posture colours differ, not 9. (3) Story and unit panels collide below about 652 px, not at 768 px. Mis-diagnosis: the Compare tab clipping comes from the site-nav.css button reset forcing a computed 16 px font (declared 10 px), not from undersized controls. The report body was left unedited; the corrections and 7 missed items are appended as a "## Verification" section in app-design.md.

missed_by_specialist.title: sw.js precaches icons, manifest and apple-touch cache-first, so brand-asset and manifest fixes will not reach returning visitors
missed_by_specialist.evidence: sw.js:5-13 PRECACHE_ASSETS includes /icons/icon-192.png, /icons/icon-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png, /manifest.json; sw.js:52-55 serves them cache-first with no revalidation; CACHE_NAME='gbg-v5' (sw.js:3). Same-URL replacement of icons or removal of manifest orientation is invisible until the cache name changes, and that change then triggers the existing skipWaiting/clients.claim/controllerchange-reload path (C6).
missed_by_specialist.fix: Ship new icons and manifest under versioned URLs (or network-first for /manifest.json), remove them from PRECACHE_ASSETS, bump CACHE_NAME, and land it after the C6 fix.
